verdict.rationale: Self-serve document automation is a fair question for a law firm that markets legal tech, but the evidence shows no interactive online document assembly. The notary downloads page offers static forms and questionnaires (GmbH foundation questionnaire, starter kit, AML/KYC forms), which the story explicitly excludes. ySolutions is a software-supported service in which the firm's own unit handles transparency-register filings, not a tool founders use to assemble documents themselves; the generic legal-tech boilerplate names no such product.
